 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Chris Sutton 
Former Blackburn striker on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That was brilliantly worked. The run by Jack Hinshelwood was sensational. 
 Hinshelwood makes an overlap, he dinks Gianluigi Donnarumma, but it goes into the side netting.
 112 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 16:48 GMT 16:48 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Goodness me it doesn't get much bigger than that in terms of opportunities for an equaliser.
 The ball comes to Nico O'Reilly in the area but he can't get his header on target.
 The clock is ticking but it feels like it's just not going to happen for the hosts.
 170 31 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:48 GMT 16:48 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Leeds have a free-kick right on the edge of the Bournemouth box and Anton Stach is standing over it...
 140 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 16:47 GMT 16:47 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Manchester City treading water as Georginio Rutter plays it through for Josh Hinshelwood and he powers onto the ball and gets a chipped shot away but it's into the side netting.
 202 74 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:47 GMT 16:47 GMT 
 Hull City 2-2 Ipswich Town 
 Both sides could still win this. A couple of chances for Ipswich as Jack Clarke has an effort blocked by Semi Ajayi, with Julio Enciso curling the rebound wide.
 62 12 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:46 GMT 16:46 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 It is all Leeds right now as they search desperately for an equaliser but Bournemouth are continuing to shut them out. 
 192 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:46 GMT 16:46 GMT 
 Hull City 2-2 Ipswich Town 
 Jack Clarke floats a dangerous free-kick through the Hull penalty area, but none of four Ipswich players attacking it can get a touch to send it at goal.
 62 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:46 GMT 16:46 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Phil Foden links up with Jeremy Doku down the left and wriggles free but his cross is blocked at close range.
 City running out of time and facing the prospect of back-to-back Premier League defeats.
 35 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 16:44 GMT 16:44 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 A couple of Leeds changes as Harry Wilson and James Justin make way for Brenden Aaronson and Jean-Matteo Bahoya.
 Into the final five minutes we go. 
 227 45 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:44 GMT 16:44 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Brighton win a corner late on.
 A goal here would well and truly put this one to bed but it doesn't beat the first man.
 272 140 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:44 GMT 16:44 GMT 
 Coventry 3-1 Sunderland 
 A break in play here as Carl Rushworth receives some treatment. Only a few minutes to go.
 97 35 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:43 GMT 16:43 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Dominic Calvert-Lewin rises like a salmon but it flicks off the top of his head. 
 Leeds do damage to keep it high in the Bournemouth half though. 
 Image source, Getty Images

 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Sean Longstaff forces a corner for Leeds.

 Post published at 16:42 GMT 16:42 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Jayden Bogle fires a ball in from wide but it's straight at Djorde Petrovic. 
 Another Leeds attack that comes to nothing. 
 111 178 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:41 GMT 16:41 GMT 
 Coventry 3-1 Sunderland 
 Matt Grimes replaces Victor Torp as Coventry look to see out these final stages for a victory that will lift them out of the relegation zone.
 170 42 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 16:41 GMT 16:41 GMT 
 Brentford 2-0 Nottm Forest 
 Callum Wilson comes on for Kevin Schade.
 80 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GREAT SAVE! published at 16:41 GMT 16:41 GMT 
 Hull City 2-2 Ipswich Town 
 Two great chances for Hull to retake the lead.
 Firstly, Issa Diop does really well to clear the ball off the line after Ipswich captain Dara O'Shea had headed the ball goalbound past his own goalkeeper.
 Then Tigers sub Brooke Norton-Cuffy almost finds the bottom corner, only to be denied by a superb save by a full-length dive from Christian Walton.
 120 39 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 16:40 GMT 16:40 GMT 
 Brentford 2-0 Nottm Forest 
 How many times has Kevin Schade been fouled when he's about to race clear?
 James McAtee drags him back and goes straight into the referee's book.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 94 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:40 GMT 16:40 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Brighton 
 Rayan Cherki whips the ball in and it's headed behind for a corner by Costinha.
 Phil Foden's delivery bundles around in the area but won't drop for a clean shot for anyone in sky blue.
 152 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 16:40 GMT 16:40 GMT 
 Bournemouth 1-0 Leeds 
 Leeds just don't seem to have enough going forward to break this Bournemouth side down.
